paragraphResults.brief_reason: The definition of 'Additional Countries' includes a statement that Miltenyi shall have no obligation to continue supplying the product after a 6-month period, which contradicts Section 3.2(h) that requires continued supply beyond 6 months under certain conditions.

evidence.snippet_a: Miltenyi shall have no obligation to continue supplying the applicable Miltenyi Product without such change after expiry of the said 6month period, regardless of whether Bellicum has secured an alternate source of supply from a Third Party manufacturer.
evidence.snippet_b: Miltenyi will continue to supply the applicable Miltenyi Product without such change after expiry of the said 6-month period and during the Term of this Agreement, or until Bellicum has secured an alternate source of supply from a Third Party manufacturer

paragraphResults.brief_reason: The paragraph states Bellicum must purchase all products after a Material Change, but Section 3.2(g) and (h) provide exceptions where Bellicum has no such obligation.

evidence.snippet_a: Bellicum shall be obligated to purchase all Miltenyi Products produced after implementation of such Material Change in accordance with Article 5.
evidence.snippet_b: any limitations on or obligations of Bellicum under Article 5 pertaining to forecast variances and Firm Zone ordering in relation to Miltenyi Products described in this subsection (g) shall not apply, and therefore Bellicum has no obligation to purchase any such Miltenyi Products produced after implementation of such Material Change.

paragraphResults.brief_reason: The paragraph redefines 'Forecast' in a way that contradicts the definition provided in Article 5.

evidence.snippet_a: the term “Forecast” shall not derive its meaning from Article 5 of this Agreement but shall instead mean any non-binding estimate of future purchase quantities provided by the Buyer.
evidence.snippet_b: “Forecast” shall have the meaning provided in Article 5 of this Agreement.
